description: Three sawtooth oscillators detuned from each other and summed to one output, with corner rounding and a hard-sync switch for each of the two upper oscillators.

params.text: Sets the pitch of all three oscillators in volts, -3 to +3; 0V gives C4 at 261.63Hz.
Shifts the pitch of all three by up to half an octave either way.
Rounds the corners of the waveform, 0.0001 at the left for the sharpest shape through to 0.1 at the right for the roundest.
Spreads the three oscillators apart in pitch, unison at the left through to a full octave between neighbours at the right.
Toggles oscillator 2 restarting at the beginning of every cycle of oscillator 1; the lamp is lit while that is on and the setting is stored with the patch.
Toggles oscillator 3 restarting at the beginning of every cycle of oscillator 2; the lamp is lit while that is on and the setting is stored with the patch.

inputs.text: Pitch at a volt per octave, added to FREQ; the number of channels patched here sets the module's polyphony.
Shifts the pitch by a fifth of an octave per volt, added to FINE.
Adds 0.01 to THETA per volt, and the total is held inside the knob's own range.
Adds to DETUNE, -5V adding no spread and +5V adding a full octave of it; the total is not held inside the knob's range.

outputs.text: The three oscillators added together and divided by three, -5V to +5V.

notes: The pitch from the two knobs and the two pitch inputs together is limited to three and a half octaves either side of C4.
Detuning raises the two upper oscillators: oscillator 2 by one detune step above the main pitch and oscillator 3 by two.

inputs.0:
1V per octave · continuous · polyphonic

the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±3.5V.
inputs.1:
continuous · polyphonic

the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±3.5V.
